narrative.narrative: Bitfinex clean-asset flow turned to a 50.2 million dollar outflow from a 68.2 million dollar inflow, so dollars are now leaving that venue instead of arriving. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Bybit's outflow widened to 103.8 million dollars from 26.1 million, while Bitstamp intake rose to 304.4 million dollars from 290.5 million and Binance intake eased to 545.8 million dollars from 553.6 million.
